data.title: 芙宁娜 · 化妆镜前软凳独处
data.description: 盛大歌剧谢幕后，更衣间内重归静谧。芙宁娜坐在化妆台前的绒面软凳上，身上的蓝白双色礼服外套已褪下搭在椅背，露出轻盈的吊带内衬与纤美锁骨。她双手反扣在凳背上，歪头望向门口的你，镜周一圈暖黄灯泡在镜中晕染开温暖的光环，眼中终于流露出卸下舞台负荷后的纯真放松与甜美笑意。
data.location: 歌剧院后台私人化妆间全身镜前
data.action: 反向坐在软凳上，双手搭着椅背，礼服外衣微解搭于椅上，神态轻松带笑看向观众
data.lighting: 化妆镜灯泡环形暖光与室内柔光
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, cowboy shot, eye level
data.mood: 谢幕后的卸防、信赖与纯真笑意
data.promptProse: Furina sits facing the viewer on her dressing room stool in a sheer blue and white chiffon dress with slender straps, her bare shoulders, collarbone, and cleavage illuminated by the warm glow of the vanity mirror bulbs as her heterochromatic eyes look up with a shy blush.
data.animaCaption: Sitting at the theatre vanity stool facing the viewer, her thin-strapped chiffon dress highlights her collarbone, cleavage, and bare shoulders.
